si: SI-generated (AI): Claude Code wrote the script that produced this file during the event; reviewed by the team.
regla: ADR-0003 R1, global rule Mexico+Argentina with N=20 plus official notices (Terra 2001-06-15..07-02 and 2016-02-18..28). A month is INCOMPLETE if some day has NO MODIS platform with data; a day with a single platform without data is backed up by the other (it does not make the month incomplete).
cobertura_modis_en_serie: 2000-12 to 2011-12 (MODIS is in the series only until Dec 2011; from Jan 2012 the series is VIIRS)

mes_en_curso.nota: month to date; the last NRT days are provisional

nota_ausencia_de_fila: In mensual/*.csv a cell-month without a row means 0 detections, EXCEPT when the month is in meses_incompletos (then it is 'no data', never 0).
